seedPackets.title: Teacup Window Weather Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free, offline printable paper story seed packet for turning a yard or window view into sensory writing, not real seeds.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print one packet, set it on the table, choose a yard or window view, and remind the kid this is paper-only, with look, listen, point, sketch, and imagine choices.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look through the window view or across the yard. Pick one color, one sound, and one pretend weather-window message for Teacup Town.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: Packet label: Teacup Town saves today's paper story seed as ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Detail seeds: I can look at color ____________________, listen for sound ____________________, and sketch shape ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A tiny window watcher sees ____________________ and imagines the town needs a calmer plan.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: Sprout sentence path: First the watcher notices ____________________. Then the window clue seems to say ____________________. Last the watcher writes ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one sensory word to make the window view clearer: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to one safe detail and write only one tiny label: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At the table, turn this paper story seed into three sentences about ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Acorn Errand Desk Character Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free, offline printable paper story seed packet for inventing a helpful character from a yard, porch view, or table detail.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print one packet, place it on the table or clipboard, choose a yard or porch view, and keep the activity paper-only, look-only, and imagination-led.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look, listen, point, sketch, and imagine one careful Acorn errand helper who notices a safe detail from your view.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: Packet label: The Acorn errand desk files a paper story seed named ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Character seeds: helper job ____________________, careful habit ____________________, small worry ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The errand helper notices ____________________ and decides the message needs a kinder character choice.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: Sprout sentence path: My helper wants ____________________, checks ____________________, and chooses to say ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace a plain character word with a more exact describing word: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the helper's badge shape, then write one character word: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At the table, tell a short Acorn errand story starring ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Pocket Park Setting Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free, offline printable paper story seed packet for building a Pocket Park setting from a yard, garden view, table, or park edge.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print one packet, choose a yard, garden view, table, or park edge, and invite looking, listening, pointing, sketching, and imagining only.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Imagine the Pocket Park board needs one setting clue. Look for a broad detail, point to it, then sketch how it changes the scene.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: Packet label: Pocket Park pins a paper story seed for the setting called ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Setting seeds: I can sketch a line ____________________, a color ____________________, and a quiet sound ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A new notice appears beside ____________________, changing how the tiny park setting feels.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: Sprout sentence path: The setting starts as ____________________. A new detail changes it to ____________________. My character feels ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one view-safe detail that helps the reader picture the setting: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to one shape, sketch it small, and name it here: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At the table, use this setting seed to write about ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Button Bakery Order Mix-Up Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free, offline printable paper story seed packet for shaping a beginning, middle, and ending from porch view, table, or yard details.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print one packet, fold it like a pretend bakery wrapper, choose a table, porch view, or yard, and keep the work paper-only and eyes-only.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look, listen, point, sketch, and imagine three safe details you can see from one view; make them the order of a Button Bakery mix-up.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: Packet label: Button Bakery wraps a paper story seed called ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Sequence seeds: beginning detail ____________________, middle clue ____________________, ending choice ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The bakery note points first to ____________________, but the next clue changes the order.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one reason the middle clue belongs after the beginning: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number three boxes silently, then write the first box word: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At the table, turn the three clues into a Button Bakery scene about ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Greenhouse Gear Revision Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free, offline printable paper story seed packet for using a garden view or window view pattern to revise one story sentence.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print one packet, choose a garden view, window view, or table, and keep it paper-only while the kid looks, listens, sketches, points, and imagines.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look for a repeating shape, color, or sound in the garden view. Imagine Greenhouse Gear Garden uses that pattern to make a draft clearer.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: Packet label: Greenhouse Gear Garden stores a paper story seed named ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Revision seeds: repeated shape ____________________, repeated sound ____________________, sentence to improve ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The gear keeper hears ____________________ repeat and realizes one story sentence needs a clearer pattern.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: Sprout sentence path: Draft sentence: ____________________. Better detail: ____________________. Revised sentence: ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Make the revised sentence stronger by adding one exact sound, color, or shape: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the pattern silently, then revise one word here: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At the table, use this paper story seed to polish a Greenhouse Gear Garden paragraph about ____________________.
